title: TROVE: Adaptive Agent Skill Orchestration via Trace-Grounded Route Validation and Editing
abstract: arXiv:2609.05019v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agents tend to optimize, select, or constrain execution structures before decisive runtime outcomes are observed. However, such pre-execution commitment creates an orchestration bottleneck: when intermediate evidence invalidates the pending continuation, agents must either execute stale steps or replan broadly, compounding errors, wasting computation, and discarding progress. We thus propose Trace-grounded Route Orchestration via Validation and Editing (TROVE), which revises only what runtime evidence invalidates. Offline, TROVE distills evaluated workflow-search traces into atomic and composite skills and an outcome-conditioned transition graph, preserving stable fragments while exposing outcome-dependent decisions. Online, it treats a planned route as provisional: after committing one top-level skill, the controller retains a valid continuation, inserts a trace-supported local response, or replaces only the invalid suffix. translated_title: TROVE：基于轨迹验证与编辑的智能体自适应技能编排
translated_abstract: 智能体往往在观察到决定性的运行时结果之前，就对执行结构进行优化、选择或约束。然而，这种预先执行的承诺造成了编排瓶颈：当中间证据表明待执行的后续步骤已失效时，智能体要么执行过时的步骤，要么进行大规模的重新规划，从而导致错误累积、计算浪费并丢弃已有进展。为此，我们提出了基于轨迹的验证与编辑路由编排方法（TROVE），它仅对被运行时证据证明无效的部分进行修订。在离线阶段，TROVE 将经过评估的工作流搜索轨迹提炼为原子技能与复合技能，以及一个以结果为条件的转移图，在保留稳定片段的同时，暴露出依赖于结果的决策点。在在线阶段，它将规划好的路由视为临时方案：在提交一个顶层技能后，控制器会保留仍然有效的后续步骤、插入有轨迹支持的局部响应，或仅替换失效的后缀部分。评估（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: TROVE 提出了一种基于运行时轨迹证据的自适应智能体技能编排方法：离线将工作流搜索轨迹提炼为技能库与结果条件转移图，在线则将规划路由视为临时方案，仅对被运行时证据证伪的后缀进行局部验证与编辑，从而避免整体重规划造成的错误累积和计算浪费。
en_tdlr: TROVE proposes adaptive agent skill orchestration that distills evaluated workflow-search traces into atomic/composite skills and an outcome-conditioned transition graph offline, and online treats planned routes as provisional—validating continuations and editing only the suffix invalidated by runtime trace evidence, avoiding costly full replanning and error compounding.
